_scale.formality: TONE, not construction. 0 = casual, playful, personal · 1 = serious, official, suited to long formal text. Blocky or geometric display fonts are informal even though they look 'built'.
_scale.quirkiness: 0 = standard, conventional shapes · 1 = highly stylized or decorative. Anchors from the user's review: 站酷庆科黄油体 0.7, 站酷快乐体 0.45.
_scale.how: Scored by looking at similarity/specimens/<id>.png. The user's corrections live in overrides.json and win over these.
_scale.display: 0 = made for reading body text · 1 = made for headlines, posters, logos. Heavy display fonts (得意黑, 庆科黄油体, 快乐体) read as their own group, far from text fonts.
